ordering: SIF_train.csv rows followed by SIF_test.csv rows; never uses id; preserves duplicate records.
sgf_record_matching: Exact tuple (SMILES, source_name, SIF_class, SGF_class), occurrence-aware. Identical duplicate observations have no recoverable original identity beyond CSV row.
projection: One unsupervised 3D embedding fitted to all 513 records. SIF/SGF filter membership only. 2D is the same 3D embedding viewed along Z with orthographic projection; no refitting or jitter.
